recommended_phase_2d_intervention.rationale: Corrected v2 funnel (current-target view): 515 legally-buyable exposures, 6 purchased, 509 rejected at shop exit. Classification (eligible lobby×archetype): B=130, A=85, D=0, C=6. Prior 2,516-case B_AVAILABLE_NOT_BOUGHT headline invalidated (see invalidated_prior_results). Most legally-buyable relevant cores are rejected at shop exit without purchase — build-aware recruiting is the strongest measured gap. Hindsight final-target mean coverage: 0.011 (labeled hindsight only).
